systems.name: Git repository
systems.location: repository checkout and remote Git host
systems.role: Code, contracts, small results, findings, notebook, claims, and paper source
systems.authority: Canonical text and small machine-readable record

systems.name: Speck runtime artifact store
systems.role: Datasets, checkpoints, full logs, predictions, traces, exports, and temporary files
systems.authority: Artifact bytes only when identified by a checked manifest and digest

systems.name: Weights & Biases
systems.location: remote service plus ignored local wandb directory
systems.role: Live metrics, charts, and operational monitoring
systems.authority: Convenience mirror; never the sole scientific record

systems.name: Linear
systems.role: Work queue, ownership, dependencies, and status communication
systems.authority: Operational state; never the sole scientific record

systems.name: Publication archive
systems.location: Hugging Face and a DOI-minting repository selected before release
systems.role: Public models, data metadata, code snapshot, paper, and research compendium
systems.authority: Immutable release snapshot after publication audit

lifecycle.name: Design and freeze
lifecycle.record: Draft plan in Git, followed by immutable experiment inputs
lifecycle.exit_gate: Question, controls, metrics, stopping, budget, analysis, and input identities are explicit

lifecycle.name: Execute and retain
lifecycle.record: Run manifest, outcomes, attempt history, and artifact identities
lifecycle.exit_gate: Declared runs and failures are accounted for

lifecycle.name: Analyze and communicate
lifecycle.record: Checked results, durable findings, current status, and paper claims
lifecycle.exit_gate: Conclusions are traceable to the declared evidence and uncertainty

lifecycle.name: Close and archive
lifecycle.record: Original paths, hashes, reproduction revisions, and release identities
lifecycle.exit_gate: Completed work is findable and verified outside the active tree
